d: Long, flowing lavender hair with straight bangs and a small side ponytail. Narrow, sharp red eyes with a confident expression. A youthful face with a mature demeanor and a slender build. Wearing a black open jacket over a black halter-neck top, black shorts with a silver-buckled belt, fishnet stockings, and high-heeled black boots with magenta accents. Holding a massive black mechanical sword with glowing magenta circular patterns, flanked by two floating, circular pink holographic energy rings.
